title: SB2002 (2020 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2020/bills/SB2002_.HTM; sha256 fc0615578850f505d2583c2b4a434c5a3f10d7c0fd3de68d1e4a4fa9e2d8d486)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced). The section is new (adds a section to chapter 134). Intoxicated means impaired by alcohol or .08 breath or blood level; possession excludes the person's own dwelling.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new): It shall be unlawful for a person to possess a loaded firearm while the person is intoxicated.
SECTION 1 (new): Any person violating this section shall be guilty of a petty misdemeanor.
